julia_cs: Heads-up 10: Sentinel Clinic signed the Private deployment SOW and submitted a redaction+triage model bundle. Need help coordinating onboarding and safety evals.
omar_eng: please paste S3 path and model meta. We'll need size, format, and any custom ops.
julia_cs: s3://sentinel-onboard/redact-triage-2026.tar.gz. Model ~9.5B, HF format (pytorch), includes custom tokenizers and a small ruleset. They flagged that training data contained provider notes (PHI).
nina_research: ask for their redaction spec and failure mode tolerances. Do they want conservative redaction (high recall) or conservative utility?
julia_cs: They want high recall on direct identifiers (>99.7%) and accept some over-redaction for names/locations. Also require a low false-negative rate on "critical" triage labels.
ben_sre: compliance checklist: KMS/HSM mandatory, token-level audit logging, and immutable export (CSV) for regulators. Also network peering + egress block.
omar_eng: runtime question: FP16 or quantized? If we quantize, we'll run sensitivity tests. Also need to integrate webhook for manual overrides.
julia_cs: Customer prefers FP16 initially; will allow quant if we show no drop in recall. Webhook details and example prompts uploaded in the bucket.
deploy-bot: Created deploy ticket INFRA-9991 for Sentinel onboarding (KMS peering + IAM).
legal_tess: I'll review the DPA and SOW in the bucket, focusing on logging retention and deletion windows. Expect comments by EOD +2.
nina_research: I'll run safety suites: redaction recall, triage FNR on critical cases, and adversarial prompt tests. Propose thresholds: critical FNR < 2.5%, redaction hallucination < 0.4%.
omar_eng: canary plan: 1k req/day, p95 < 350ms on Dedicated V100/A100 equiv. We'll collect per-field recall and exportable audit CSVs.
julia_cs: Enablement requested: 90-min session for devs + ops covering endpoints, audit exports, and override flow. They asked for Tues 9am PT next week.
ben_sre: need their KMS ARN and subnet list for peering. Also confirm HSM type (cloud or on-prem).
julia_cs: All info is in S3: s3://sentinel-onboard/README.md. I'll notify them to share KMS details in the secure intake form.
legal_tess: tagging that final payment is tied to passing the redaction recall test per SOW. Flagging potential renewal risk if SLA or export features are delayed.
nina_research: timeline: running eval harness on staging; aim to post results in 4 business days. If redaction recall passes, schedule canary.
omar_eng: noted. I'll open infra subtasks for webhook integration and audit hooks.
julia_cs: Thanks team 44D I'll update Sentinel after legal signoff.
